metadata.description: A collection of skills and tools for Claude Code

plugins.name: prose
plugins.description: Revise prose for clarity and busy readers, add sourced footnotes, strip references the reader cannot see, cut AI tells from any writing, and lint Markdown with Vale

plugins.name: norsk
plugins.description: Write and revise documentation in controlled technical Norwegian - klarspråk per NS-ISO 24495-1 with ASD-STE100 principles

plugins.name: plain-language
plugins.description: Restate a message in plain human language, or ask for a re-pitch when it does not land

plugins.name: pull-requests
plugins.description: Open a GitHub pull request from the repository's own template, manage stacked branches and pull requests with gh-stack, and attach images and videos to issues and pull requests

plugins.name: github-actions
plugins.description: Run GitHub Actions workflow steps in parallel, replace repeated workflow configuration with YAML anchors, name every workflow, job, and step, and pin every action reference to a commit SHA on workflow edits

plugins.name: dependencies
plugins.description: Hold new dependency releases for a cooldown, configure Renovate, freeze install commands to their lock files, and deny install-time script execution

plugins.name: toolchain
plugins.description: Pin a project's tools to a mise toolchain, and run Git hooks with prek

plugins.name: grilling
plugins.description: Grill a plan until its design tree holds, and write the outcome up as domain terms and architecture decisions

plugins.name: fresh-eyes
plugins.description: Look at a module with fresh eyes and keep the simplest redesigns that survive its constraints

plugins.name: browser
plugins.description: Drive Chrome, web apps, and Electron apps from the command line with the agent-browser CLI

plugins.name: show-me
plugins.description: Explain the topic at hand visually with diagrams, code-shape sketches, and focused HTML

plugins.name: skill-authoring
plugins.description: Write documents for agents, analyze a skill, prune the prose that changes no behavior, and split broad references into focused files

plugins.name: retro
plugins.description: Retrospect on a coding session to improve the environment the next one runs in

plugins.name: flashcards
plugins.description: Turn text, notes, code, or images into Anki flashcards built on Andy Matuschak's prompt-writing principles
